pages.quiz:
WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

2. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.

3. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.

4. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.

7. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.

8. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Detailed drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Detailed drawing.

9. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.

10. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.

11. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Finishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Project activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

5. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.

7. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

12. D — CPU
